4. World Almanac/Deities/The Trickster G.text: The Trickster God is Roark Battleborn's father.
4. World Almanac/Deities/The Trickster G.learned: S40 Secrets of the Silent Ascendency

4. World Almanac/Factions/Silent Ascende.text: The Silent Ascendency has been draining stolen magic items to fuel a ritual.

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Marrow.md.text: Marrow was the Silent Ascendency's cell leader in Bruokdon.
Marrow captured and impersonated Lord Caldris Velmont, then Professor Gousse Windcaller, and escaped into a crowd when Faerah saw through it.
Marrow took Roark Battleborn's identity; Faerah saw through it and killed Marrow in single combat.
